_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

someone-elses-hardware.text: Every leaderboard you have read measures someone else's hardware, in a datacentre you will never see.

where-people-quit.text: So you choose by parameter count, hope it fits, and never find out what your own machine can do.

open.text: This one measures yours. Forty-two curated models, fourteen prompts, on the box you already have.

needs-ollama.text: Local Bench talks to Ollama. With no daemon running, it shows the catalog and says so.

models-installed.text: Start Ollama and the catalog comes alive. Anything you have already pulled becomes selectable.

pick-a-prompt.text: Pick a prompt, edit it, and run that exact text against the selected models.

browse-prompts.text: Fourteen prompts, from coding to operations. Expand one to read it first.

run-it.text: Select what you have installed and run it. Models you have not pulled stay disabled.

benchmark-complete.text: A benchmark finishes on the Ollama host you selected, with the result saved for comparison.

system-specs.text: Every result records the processor, memory, and graphics hardware behind the run.

response-compare.text: Speed is only half the question. Compare what each model actually wrote.

model-intelligence.text: Use the intelligence table as context before you download another model.

read-the-docs.text: The docs ship inside the app: what each number means, and how to budget agents.

recap.text: Selected models run through Ollama, and the results live in a local SQLite file.

close.text: Benchmark before you commit with Local Bench. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.

first-run.text: One page, no account. The whole catalog is browsable before you install anything.
